title: ACE, Higher Education Groups Urge IRS to Withdraw Rule Threatening Colleges' Tax-Exempt Status
summary_en: ACE and 40 other higher education associations are urging the IRS to withdraw a proposal that could strip private, nonprofit colleges and universities of their tax-exempt status.
title_cn: ACE, Higher Education Groups Urge IRS to Withdraw Rule Threatening Colleges' Tax-Exempt Status
